scope: Align Firefox site permissions with the security shield in the address bar.
approval: Maintainer approved the before-and-after light and dark comparison for publication.

checks.command: KDE neon guest running Firefox 159.0.1: capture an HTTPS page with a granted site permission and measure both icon rectangles before and after applying the CSS in light and dark mode. The vertical offset fell from 6 CSS pixels to zero in each mode.

coverage_limits: One Firefox version in a disposable Plasma guest. Both editions use the same browser stylesheet.
